Jwt._comment: SigningKey is deliberately NOT here - it is a secret and must come from configuration/environment only (Jwt__SigningKey / infra/docker/.env, or `dotnet user-secrets` for a local non-Docker run). See docs/security/secrets-policy.md.

Import._comment: S3-BE-01 DoD: the upload size cap is read from here, never hardcoded. 50 MiB default. MaxEntityCount (S3-SEC-01 finding H-01) bounds parse work independently of upload size - see ImportOptions.cs.

Excel._comment: EPPlus 8 license (Polyform Noncommercial by default). CM+ is a commercial product - CommercialLicenseKey must be set from a real license (env var Excel__CommercialLicenseKey) before production; see ExcelPackageLicense.cs. NonCommercialOrganizationName is validated by EPPlus as a plain name (letters/digits/spaces only), hence no '+'/punctuation.
Excel.NonCommercialOrganizationName: CM Plus Project Control Dev Eval

Photos._comment: S12-BE-01 DoD: the upload size cap is read from here, never hardcoded. 10 MiB default - generous headroom above the ~300 KB client-side-compressed photo S12-FE-01 targets.

Storage._comment: ADR-0010: local-disk IFileStorage adapter (dev/staging only - an S3-API-compatible adapter lands after the Sprint 16 provider gate). Deliberately outside this repo and outside the API's content root; see LocalDiskFileStorage.cs. LocalRootPath left unset here on purpose - defaults to a path under the OS temp directory.

Login._comment: sprint-15-owasp.md M-1: POST /api/v1/auth/login throttle. Chained per-IP AND per-account (normalized email) sliding windows - see LoginRateLimiterSetup.cs. Defaults live in LoginRateLimitOptions.cs; these values simply make them explicit/tunable. Per-IP 10/60s covers a shared-NAT office; per-account 5/300s is the credential-stuffing backstop (rotating IPs still converge on one email). Set Enabled=false only in test environments.

Idempotency._comment: S13-BE-01/S13-DB-01 (ADR-0005 US-13.1) documented retention policy - see docs/db-conventions.md §10 and IdempotencyOptions.cs for the full reasoning. CompletedRetention (90 days) matches the worst-case offline-device reconnect window the client's own outbox tests already treat as ordinary; InProgressRetention (1 day) reclaims an abandoned reservation whose owning request never completed or released it.
